# Actalink

> Actalink is the payment interface layer for stablecoins — infrastructure powering the complete lifecycle of stablecoin payments, from storing assets and funding accounts to accepting payments and spending anywhere card payments are accepted. One company, four products, one interoperable platform.

Actalink connects every stage of the stablecoin payment journey through four products that each work independently but compound together:

- Bexo (Store): self-custody wallet with gasless transactions — your keys, your funds, Banking On-Chain.
- OpenDeposit (Deposit): embedded infrastructure that lets applications accept stablecoin deposits from connected wallets.
- ActaPay (Accept): merchant payment gateway for online and in-store stablecoin payments with payment links, subscriptions, invoices, POS, and instant settlement.
- Straight (Spend): stablecoin card network enabling users to spend directly from self-custody wallets anywhere card payments are accepted.
